package.description: Free on-device voice typing for any app, plus Crop & Speak — annotate a region of your screen and narrate it into ChatGPT or Claude. No cloud, no caps, no account.

en-US.description: Free on-device voice typing for any app, plus Crop & Speak — annotate a region of your screen and narrate it into ChatGPT or Claude. No cloud, no caps, no account.
en-US.longDescription: CroppickVoice types what you say into any Windows app, with speech recognition that runs on your device by default. Crop & Speak captures a region of your screen so you can annotate it and narrate it into ChatGPT, Claude, or any chat. The on-device core is free; Pro adds opt-in cloud providers (bring your own key), per-app profiles, and persistent history.
en-US.name: CroppickVoice
